"REL is a dagger category: the converse R† = { (b, a) | (a, b) ∈ R } is an involution ... None of that extra structure is built here; this file constructs the bare category, its initial object ..., and the wide embedding Coq ⟶ Rel of functions as relations."

statement_record.book: Rel has as objects all small sets and as arrows R : X -> Y the relations R ⊆ X×Y; the composite is the relative product S.R = {<x,z> | ∃y, <x,y>∈R ∧ <y,z>∈S}; the identity on X is the diagonal; the category axioms hold; Rel contains Set as a subcategory via graphs of functions; and Rel carries the extra structure of a converse relation R† : Y -> X.

statement_record.book: A concrete category is a pair <C, U> where C is a category and U : C -> Set is a faithful functor; equivalently, a category in which every object has an underlying set, every arrow is an actual function between underlying sets, and composition of arrows is composition of functions.
